t: Comedy Legends from The Ed Sullivan Show
st: Ep. 9: Jack Carter, Vic Greco and Fred Willard, Irwin C. Watson, Jim Nabors
d: Jack Carter's "Rock n' Roll Generation"; Vic Greco and Fred Willard's "Interview: Body Building Movie, Bank Robber"; Irwin C. Watson's "Children Talkback, Bad Luck, Dates"; Jim Nabors' "Dating in Hollywood"

st: Comic Legends Of The '90s - Kevin Nealon (3/19/85)
d: SNL star Kevin Nealon tells a story about getting a live lobster and setting it free – in a forest.  Charles Grodin and Linda Thorsen are also on the show.

t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
st: Peter Lawford, Minnie Pearl
d: The Rat Pack meets The Burnett Bunch when Peter Lawford guests!

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S4 E23 - Bob Newhart
d: Guest star Bob Newhart appears in "Carol & Sis" as Roger's accountant, whose wife makes Carol feel inferior. Also: a hungover Harvey discovers an even bigger headache: Fireside Girl Alice Portnoy.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Jim Fowler (12/15/81)
d: Animal trainer Jim Fowler brings a baby baboon and golden eagle onto the set, and Johnny’s next guest, writer Gore Vidal, exclaims that he should have brought his pet lizard.

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S6 E22 - David Hartman, Paula Kelly
d: Tonight's guests are David Hartman and Paula Kelly! Featured characters include washed up actress Nora Desmond and the long-suffering couple George and Zelda. Also featured: "This Is Your Lifetime."

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S4 E16 - Pat Carroll, Art Carney
d: Carol welcomes Art Carney and Pat Carroll to the show! Art plays an exterminator suffering from performance anxiety, then he and Pat appear on the latest "As The Stomach Turns" episode.

st: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (6/21/79)
d: Celebrities at the pump; Burt Reynolds talks about waiting for his turn. He also fesses up to coveting an Oscar.  Jimmy Carter’s mom, Miss Lillian, admits she doesn’t like sleeping at the White House.

t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
st: Neil Sedaka
d: Guest Neil Sedaka joins the gang for a set of commercial parodies.

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S10 E22 - Neil Sedaka
d: Guest Neil Sedaka joins the gang for a set of commercial parodies. Also: Harvey learns to not pick up on ladies at the I.R.S. office, and Carol tries to get important houseguests to call it a night.

t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
st: Tim Conway
d: Tim Conway is back again as guest star in this episode, highlighted by his turn as a hapless bus boy at a 'Beniha-ha' restaurant

t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
st: Goldie Hawn, Dom DeLuise (9/18/1969)
d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Goldie Hawn and Dom DeLuise.

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S4 E11 - Dyan Cannon, Paul Lynde
d: Tonight's guests are Dyan Cannon and Paul Lynde! Lynde plays a smarmy insurance salesman, and later appears in Canoga Falls in Cannon on "As The Stomach Turns."

st: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (12/13/78)
d: The legendary Joan Rivers talks giving birth and politics, but not necessarily at the same time. Also appearing are Ann Margret and Lou Holtz.

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S9 E6 - Maggie Smith
d: Maggie Smith guest stars tonight, playing Tim's girlfriend in a sketch where he is honored with christening a ship...which he refuses to do, much to the chagrin of the Queen. Also: a parody of "Jaws."

t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
st: Alan King
d: Comedian Alan King guest stars as Carol's distracted psychiatrist.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Tim Allen (1/29/92)
d: Tim Allen, Melanie Griffith and......the great dog photos by famed photographer William Wegman

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S9 E14 - Family Show
d: Tonight, Tim and Harvey are opposing generals at the signing of a peace treaty between Japan and Russia, while "The Family" gathers to head off for the funeral of Mama's sister Mae.

t: Comedy Legends from The Ed Sullivan Show
st: Ep. 1: Joan Rivers, Carl Reiner and Mel Brooks, Moms Mabley, Henny Youngman
d: Joan Rivers' "Last Girl Married"; Carl Reiner and Mel Brooks' "2,000 Year-Old Man"; Moms Mabley's "Men and Marriage"; Henny Youngman's "Gambling"

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S11 E7 - Family Show
d: Tonight's line-up of sketches is highlighted by Dick Van Dyke as a television announcer who is forced to fill in when technical difficulties scuttle the airing of the late night movie.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Lauren Bacall (6/23/83)
d: Screen star and two-time Tony winner Lauren Bacall talks about her new play, life in LA, and quitting smoking for the fifth time.

t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
st: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show Ep. 88
d: Ed Sullivan presents Sammy Davis, Jr., The Barry Sisters, Rickie Layne and Velvel, Fred Kaps, Sergio Franchi, and Ugo Garrido.

st: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dana Carvey (3/11/87)
d: The Church Lady makes an appearance on the show when Dana Carvey stops by and does impressions. Plus, Christopher Reeve talks Superman and Frank Olivier does a juggling/comedy act.

t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
st: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show Ep. 46
d: Ed Sullivan presents Jackie Wilson, Georgia Brown, Milton Berle, Frank Ifield, The Amin Brothers, and Al Hirt.
